title: Case 016: Garden Door Repair Request
initial_request:
From Tenant:
I seem to have a slight problem with my back / garden door. It is a little difficult to close. It could possibly be the heat, but it is also creaking and not closing smoothly. The hinges seem to be misaligned.

Please fix if simple quote if expensive. Thanks!
overview: The tenant reported that the back/garden door was difficult to close, creaking and not closing smoothly, and said its hinges appeared misaligned. The landlord approved sending a contractor after the approval email had been missed in spam. Beacon Works arranged a visit. The provider later reported that the door was working well after naturally settling, so no repair or invoice was required. The request was completed without payment.
outcome: The door was functioning well after naturally settling; no repair or invoice was required. The request was completed without payment.
